output.subject: A document parsing API built for AP automation at scale
output.pitch: Hi — I'm building DocParse, a layout-aware document parsing API that turns invoices, receipts, and purchase orders into clean, structured JSON with 99.2% field-level accuracy. We're targeting engineering teams working on AP automation and ERP integrations who are stuck with generic OCR or overpriced document AI that needs weeks of tuning. Our p95 latency is 1.8 seconds per page at any volume, with per-field confidence scores and human-in-the-loop fallback below your threshold. We've published our benchmark methodology and metrics, and we're SOC 2 Type II compliant in progress. If your readers are building back-office automation, they’ll care about accuracy they can verify and throughput they can rely on. {APP_URL}
